market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously constructive. US-China talks and M&A momentum support equities, but energy inflation, 7%+ mortgage rates, and consumer stress cap upside. FTSE 100 rebound and EM gains offset US consumer weakness. Expect volatility around Trump-Xi summit outcomes.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward AI-driven capex, energy transition bottlenecks, and fiscal sustainability concerns. Buffett's departure signals a new era at Berkshire. US-China relationship remains the dominant macro variable. Housing affordability crisis likely persists through 2027.
